label: First of the long +0.2% and short -0.2% tick-rounded barriers reached after the completed signal bar: signed exp(-(upper-bound hit minutes - 1)/5). No hit before cutoff is zero. Both first hits in one bar or missing future minutes are excluded, never guessed.
score: 2 * sigmoid(raw) - 1, estimating signed speed-discounted first-target utility, not a guaranteed return or a win probability
bar_resolution: Hit time is the end of the first touching one-minute bar, an upper bound on actual within-bar time. No seconds-level latency claim.
reference_price: Signal close is an analytical reference, not an executable fill. Target prices round away from reference on the 0.10 tick grid.
complexity_limit: Compact normalized feature families; no timestamps, session IDs or price levels as fitted predictors; shrinkage; no unbounded hyperparameter search. Audit all 47 features descriptively without treating correlated minute rows as independent days.
fit: Soft-label logistic cross-entropy on (utility+1)/2, no intercept, L2 penalty, every fifth minute with equal session weights; SciPy L-BFGS-B. No full-sample scaling or date-specific coefficients.
selection: Report forward-day error versus a neutral zero score and directional target speed/first-hit quality. Models and any changes informed by these four days remain research hypotheses, not validated trading strategies.
untouched_dates: No outcomes after September 4 are read. September 21-23 validation and September 24-28 holdout remain reserved.
contract: A single signed score reflects direction; absolute magnitude determines rank. A near-zero score can mean no fast opportunity, conflicting directions, or uncertainty, which must be distinguished in diagnostic outputs. Suppression and deterministic risk remain separate.
